big: A client with ₹3 lakh asks about a PMS. Another wants an AIF. What can an RM actually sell? It depends on certifications and the firm's approved processes. Knowing what you cannot sell matters as much as what you can.

lines: How do the four products differ?

Minimums: mutual funds from a few hundred rupees, SIFs ₹10 lakh, PMS ₹50 lakh, AIFs ₹1 crore. In funds, trades inside are not taxed in your hands until redemption. In PMS, securities sit in your demat, so each trade can create a tax event. Higher minimums mean more flexibility, not automatically better outcomes.
